description: A Central Sector scheme that provides direct direct income support to all landholding farmer families across India to meet crop input and domestic needs.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year provided in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months directly into the beneficiary's bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land registered in their name.
Excludes institutional landholders, high-income taxpayers, government employees, and constitutional post holders.
documents: Land Ownership Record (Khatauni / Land Mutation Certificate)
application_mode: Online via PM-KISAN portal or offline via Common Service Center (CSC) / State Nodal Officer

description: Comprehensive yield-based crop insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks, drought, floods, pests, and post-harvest losses.
benefits: Nominal premium rates paid by farmers: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for Annual Commercial/Horticultural crops. Remaining premium is subsidized by Central and State Governments.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers, tenant farmers, and owner-cultivators growing notified crops in notified areas.
application_mode: Online via National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP), Banks, or CSCs

description: Provides single-window institutional credit to farmers for agricultural production, post-harvest expenses, animal husbandry, and fisheries at highly subsidized interest rates.
benefits: Short-term crop loans up to ₹3 Lakh at an effective interest rate of 4% per annum (after 3% prompt repayment incentive). No collateral required for loans up to ₹1.6 Lakh.
eligibility: Individual/joint landholders, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, Self-Help Groups (SHGs), and Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) engaged in agriculture or allied activities.
documents: Identity Proof & Address Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID)
Land Ownership Documents / Crop Pattern Proof
application_mode: Offline/Online via Commercial Banks, Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), or Cooperative Banks

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) - Per Drop More Crop
description: Focuses on micro-irrigation technologies like drip and sprinkler systems to improve water-use efficiency on farms, reduce pumping costs, and boost crop productivity.
benefits: 55% financial subsidy on micro-irrigation equipment for Small and Marginal Farmers, and 45% subsidy for other farmers.
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land with an assured water source.
Members of Water User Associations and Self-Help Groups.
application_mode: Online/Offline through State Agriculture / Micro-Irrigation Departments

description: A medium-to-long term debt financing facility for creating post-harvest management infrastructure, cold chains, silos, assaying units, and community farming assets.
benefits: 3% interest subvention per annum on loans up to ₹2 Crore for a maximum period of 7 years, along with credit guarantee coverage under CGTMSE.
eligibility: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), FPOs, Agri-entrepreneurs, Startups, SHGs, and Individual Farmers.
documents: KYC and Financial Credentials of the Applicant / Entity
application_mode: Online via National Agriculture Infrastructure Fund Portal

description: Integrated now under Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY), this initiative tests farm soil chemistry to give farmers customized recommendations on nutrient dosages and organic amendments.
benefits: Free soil sample testing and issuance of a personalized Soil Health Card every 3 years containing nutrient status (12 parameters) and tailored fertilizer dosage advice.
eligibility: All farmers cultivating agricultural land across India.
application_mode: Offline soil collection through State Soil Testing Laboratories / Village Agriculture Extension Officers

description: Promotes chemical-free organic farming through cluster-based approaches, Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) certification, and marketing support.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years, of which ₹31,000 is directly provided for organic inputs (seeds, bio-fertilizers, bio-pesticides).
eligibility: Farmers forming groups/clusters of 50 or more having 50 acres of land in total.
Individual farmers adopting organic farming under certified clusters.
application_mode: Offline/Online via Regional Council under PGS-India / District Agriculture Officer

description: Supports livestock-centric, zero-chemical natural farming (Bhartiya Prakritik Krishi Paddhati) to cut input costs, restore soil organic carbon, and reduce environmental degradation.
benefits: ₹15,000 per hectare financial incentive over 3 years for adopting natural farming inputs, establishing Bio-Input Resource Centres (BHRCs), and field demonstrations.
eligibility: All landholding farmers willing to transition from chemical to natural farming.
application_mode: Online via NMNF Portal or through District Agriculture Office

description: Increases farm power availability and mechanization among small and marginal farmers by subsidizing agricultural machinery and establishing Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs).
benefits: 40% to 80% subsidy on procurement of tractors, power tillers, rotavators, combine harvesters, and up to 80% capital subsidy for establishing CHCs.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers, SC/ST, women farmers, cooperative societies, and FPOs.
application_mode: Online via Direct Benefit Transfer in Agricultural Mechanization portal

description: A voluntary and contributory pension scheme designed to provide old-age social security to small and marginal farmers when they reach 60 years of age.
benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 upon reaching the age of 60 years. Central Government matches monthly contributions made by the farmer (₹55 to ₹200/month based on entry age).
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers owning up to 2 hectares of cultivable land.
Age group between 18 and 40 years.
documents: Savings Bank Account / PM-KISAN Account Details
application_mode: Offline via Common Service Centres (CSC) or online self-enrollment

description: A pan-India electronic trading portal networking existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.
benefits: Transparent real-time online bidding, quality assaying support, access to broader buyer markets across India, and direct bank payout without intermediary deductions.
eligibility: All farmers, traders, and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) registered with participating APMC mandis.
documents: Local APMC Registration / Trader License (if applicable)
application_mode: Online via e-NAM portal or mobile app

scheme_name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
description: A scheme driving holistic growth of the horticulture sector covering fruits, vegetables, root/tuber crops, mushrooms, spices, aromatic plants, and flowers.
benefits: 40% to 80% subsidy for setting up polyhouses/greenhouses, drip irrigation, pack houses, cold storage facilities, and high-quality sapling nurseries.
eligibility: Individual horticulturists, farmer groups, SHGs, and commercial horticulture units.
application_mode: Offline/Online through State Horticulture Mission (SHM) offices

scheme_name: Formation and Promotion of 10,000 Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)
description: Focuses on mobilizing farmers into FPOs to achieve economies of scale, improve bargaining power, access credit, and gain direct market linkages.
benefits: Financial matching equity grant up to ₹2,000 per member (max ₹15 Lakh per FPO) along with credit guarantee cover up to ₹2 Crore per FPO.
eligibility: Groups of minimum 300 farmers in plain areas or 100 farmers in Hilly/North-Eastern regions formed as FPOs.
documents: FPO Registration Certificate (Companies Act / Cooperative Societies Act)
Board of Directors' Aadhaar & PAN details
application_mode: Online submission through Implementing Agencies (NABARD, SFAC, NCDC)

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
description: An umbrella scheme ensuring farmers receive fair MSP prices for pulses, oilseeds, and copra through direct physical procurement and price shortfall payment systems.
benefits: Protects farmers from market distress sales by assuring procurement at MSP (Price Support Scheme) or compensating the difference between market price and MSP (Price Deficiency Payment Scheme).
eligibility: All growers producing notified pulses, oilseeds, and oil palm crops registered on procurement portals.
application_mode: Online registration at designated procurement centers / e-Samridhi portal before harvest season

description: Equips Women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) with agricultural drones to provide rental liquid fertilizer and pesticide spraying services to local farmers.
benefits: 80% financial subsidy (up to ₹8 Lakh) provided to Women SHGs for purchasing agricultural drone packages, along with comprehensive drone pilot training.
eligibility: Active Women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) under Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM.
Selected SHG members meeting basic educational criteria for drone pilot licensing.
documents: Aadhaar Card of selected SHG Drone Pilot
SHG Registration Proof & Joint Bank Account
application_mode: Offline via State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM) Block Offices

description: A flagship scheme aimed at driving sustainable development of the fisheries sector through modernization, bio-floc aquaculture, deep-sea fishing craft, and cold chain logistics.
benefits: Capital subsidy of 40% for General category beneficiaries and 60% for SC/ST/Women for fish culture, bio-floc units, cages, motorized boats, and refrigerated vehicles.
eligibility: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, fisheries cooperatives, and women fish vendors.
documents: Fisherman ID Card / Land or Water Body Lease Document
application_mode: Online via PMMSY portal or offline via District Fisheries Office

description: Promotes scientific beekeeping to boost crop pollination, increase agricultural yields, and support honey and beehive product processing.
benefits: Up to 80% subsidy for procurement of bee boxes, bee colonies, honey extraction equipment, testing laboratories, and custom processing units.
eligibility: Individual farmers, landless agricultural workers, beekeepers, and beekeeper SHGs/FPOs.
application_mode: Online via Madhukranti Beekeeping Registration Portal / National Bee Board

description: Focuses on genetic upgradation of bovine population, conservation of indigenous bovine breeds, and increasing milk productivity through artificial insemination.
benefits: Subsidy of up to 50% (max ₹2 Crore) for setting up breed multiplication farms, free nationwide artificial insemination (NAIP) services, and sex-sorted semen assistance.
eligibility: Individual dairy entrepreneurs, FPOs, SHGs, and Section 8 companies engaged in cattle breeding.
documents: Land Ownership / Lease Documents for Dairy Farm
application_mode: Online through NLM / RGM Application Portal

scheme_name: National Mission on Edible Oils - Oil Palm (NMEO-OP)
description: Promotes oil palm cultivation to expand coverage, reduce national import dependency on edible oils, and provide price viability guarantees to growers.
benefits: ₹29,000 per hectare assistance for planting material, ₹5,000/ha/year for maintenance inputs, and a Formula Price guarantee mechanism for fresh fruit bunches (FFBs).
eligibility: Farmers owning land in notified oil palm potential districts across India.
application_mode: Offline/Online via State Agriculture/Horticulture Department

description: A focused national scheme launched to fast-track modern agricultural practices, crop diversification, and productivity enhancements across 100 high-potential agrarian districts.
benefits: Targeted funding allocations for soil health enhancement, localized cold storage units, quality seed distribution, and integrated pest management.
eligibility: Farmers operating within designated agricultural districts under the Dhan-Dhaanya program framework.
application_mode: Offline via District Agriculture Mission / Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs)
